title: MNRE Invites EoIs from Institutions to Support Hydrogen Safety Panel
summary: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has invited Expressions of Interest (EoI) from prospective agencies to select an expert institution to support the National Hydrogen Safety Panel (NHSP) under the government’s National Green Hydrogen Mission (NGHM). If selected, the institution will work closely with the MNRE, NHSP, and academic, industrial, and regulatory stakeholders. The engagement will last an initial two years and may be extended by a year based on the institution’s performance and approval by the NGHM Advisory Group.
